rules.source: The Data Protection Act, No. 24 of 2019 — enacted 8 Nov 2019 to give effect to Article 31 of the Constitution of Kenya, created the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC). Official text: https://www.odpc.go.ke/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/TheDataProtectionAct__No24of2019.pdf and Kenya Law: https://new.kenyalaw.org/akn/ke/act/2019/24
Consumer Protection Act, No. 46 of 2012 — general consumer-protection framework, prevents unfair trade practices. Official text via Kenya Law/Parliament: https://www.parliament.go.ke/node/6320

Industry Guidelines for Child Online Protection (COP) and Safety in Kenya, issued by the Communications Authority of Kenya under the Kenya Information and Communications (Consumer Protection) Regulations 2010 — safeguards for children's access to and use of ICT products/services. Official regulator: https://www.ca.go.ke/child-online-protection
Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act, 2018 (No. 5 of 2018), Cap. 79C — https://new.kenyalaw.org/akn/ke/act/2018/5/eng@2022-12-31
rules.retrieved_snippet: Assented 16 May 2018, commenced 30 May 2018; provides for offences relating to computer systems including unauthorised access (s 14), interference (s 16), interception (s 17), cyber espionage (s 21), cyber harassment (s 27), phishing (s 30), cyber terrorism (s 33) and wrongful distribution of obscene or intimate images (s 37); the Kenya Law page notes a later version exists, so check the current text.
